headline: Ero Copper Reports Higher Copper Production and Reduced Debt in Q3
summary: Ero Copper expanded its copper production in Brazil to 18.3 thousand tonnes, posted a record EBITDA of $201 million, reduced its net debt, and maintained its 2026 production guidance.
why: Mining companies' quarterly production and financial results signal supply trends in base metals and corporate earnings health for industrial investors.

impacts.name: Ero Copper Corp
impacts.why: Record EBITDA and lower debt directly strengthen the company's financial standing.
